name: Stuff the Jeep Toy Drive
paras: Heart of Missouri CASA hosts an evening at Logboat Brewing with festive activities, photos with Santa and holiday lights. The goal is to fill as many Jeeps as possible with brand-new toys for children in foster care.
Guests join the party by bringing a new, unwrapped toy to the brewery. The host asks families to invite friends, family and coworkers to take part.
tip: Bring a new, unwrapped toy to donate, since the drive runs from 5 PM to 9 PM at the brewery.

name: Pet Night with Santa at Columbia Mall
paras: Columbia Mall sets up Santa in H&M Court for pet-friendly photo evenings on Mondays and Tuesdays in December. Sessions run from 4 PM to 7 PM.
Families book a visit through the mall's Santa booking site, whereissanta.com, as listed on the mall's event page.
tip: Reserve a time on whereissanta.com before you go, since the mall lists booking there.
